title: Make a 4K iPhone Video Smaller for a School Upload
description: Compress an existing 4K iPhone recording for a school upload. Compare the file size with the portal limit and check small writing and speech.
direct: Export a smaller copy, compare its file size with the portal limit and play the portion with the smallest writing or quietest speech.
figureAlt: Realistic study desk with a student recording a worksheet from a phone stand
cards.decision.heading: Read the assignment rules
cards.decision.body: Write down the largest allowed file size and the allowed formats. If the portal asks for MP4, choose an MP4 export. Keep the source so each attempt can start with the full-quality file.
sections.detail-1.heading: If the first copy misses the limit
sections.detail-1.body: Try another preset from the original, then repeat the reading and audio checks. Ask whether two clips or a link are accepted if the only copy that fits has unreadable writing.
sections.detail-2.heading: About the app
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops this iPhone app. Check the App Store listing for current access and export options.
faqs.first-question.heading: Can I change the camera setting after recording?
faqs.first-question.body: Camera settings affect future recordings. Export a new copy to change this clip.
faqs.second-question.heading: Should I delete the original?
faqs.second-question.body: Keep it until you have checked playback and confirmed the upload.

steps.step-1.text: Open the recording in Phone Cleaner: Photo & Video and choose a smaller quality preset.
steps.step-2.text: Compare the export size with the portal limit. Leave a little room below the limit if the portal does not explain how it calculates megabytes.
steps.step-3.text: Play the exported file. Pause on the smallest writing or chart label and listen to the quietest part before you upload it.
